criteria.text: Given an added line contains a merge-conflict marker, When I commit, Then the check reports it
Given an added line introduces a focused test, When I commit, Then the check reports it
Given a staged file exceeds the size limit, When I commit, Then the check reports it
Given debugLeftover and plainEnglishCommit are off by default, When code has a console.log and the subject says seamless, Then neither is reported until enabled
Given a checks pattern appears only on a context line, When I commit, Then it is not reported
Given no findings, When I commit, Then no prompt is raised
